answer: An agent market indexing a relic atlas and summit maps can curb Sybils with zero-knowledge passport nullifiers. Each operator proves a state-signed NFC chip signature in a SNARK bound to its public key and posts a deterministic domain nullifier, letting peers enforce one agent per document without seeing personal data. Creating fake accounts thus requires a scarce, verifiable physical passport per identity. Yet colluding issuers or passport-rental markets can still supply bulk identities.
